title: Havenfall Coalition
brief: Build a shared refuge, gather medicine and food, rescue survivors and defend the community with LAN friends.
players: 1–4 LAN cooperative players; local solo campaign

chapters.title: A Place to Stay
chapters.story: Leah opens a refuge to whoever can reach it. A home begins with food, medicine and a defended door.

chapters.title: Supply Lines
chapters.story: Malik risks a supply route while June turns the refuge into something worth defending.

chapters.title: The Coalition
chapters.story: The final evacuation call is a choice: abandon the refuge or make it safe for everyone still coming.

status: development; build, gameplay, physical controller, multi-machine LAN and Steam release acceptance tracked separately
inspiration: Original characters, names, story and code; genre references are design inspiration only.
